title: Serious adverse events mar robust efficacy data for Helus’ psychedelic in major depression
snippet: Helus Pharma's psilocin-based HLP003 significantly reduced symptoms of major depressive disorder in the adjuvant setting in a Phase 3 trial but was tripped up in the stock market by three serious adverse events.

title: J&J pays $2.2B upfront for Ollin, taps Blackstone to fund eye disease trial
snippet: Blackstone will provide $750 million for Phase 3 development of Ollin Biosciences’ retinal disease bispecific as Johnson & Johnson looks to bolster its eye therapeutics pipeline after several setbacks.

title: Lilly’s early-stage M&A quest finds $1.5B deal for Calytrix’s blood cancer work
snippet: Eli Lilly's business development team has inked 14 buyouts this year so far, with Calytrix Bio tucking into the pharma’s oncology pipeline.

title: FDA’s Summit rejection puts PD-1xVEGF class on notice to establish overall survival
snippet: The FDA rejected Summit Therapeutics’ ivonescimab over the weekend, sending a strong message to rival drugmakers Bristol Myers Squibb, BioNTech, Pfizer, Merck and AbbVie.

title: Novo’s CagriSema drives more than 20% weight loss at lower doses
snippet: As Novo awaits an FDA decision for its next-gen obesity asset, the company has presented more data at ObesityWeek that could help buoy sentiment on the amylin/GLP-1 combination that disappointed investors a couple of years ago.

title: Their loss, our gain? Canada makes its case to Europe amid U.S. instability

title: ObesityWeek 2026: Wave outlines case for body composition–based trial design
snippet: Across three cohorts in Wave Life Sciences’ mid-stage trial of WVE-007, higher baseline body mass index and excessive body fat have been associated with a more pronounced effect, Rodman & Renshaw said following the company’s ObesityWeek update.

title: Rising costs leave 9 in 10 new medicines unprofitable, IQVIA finds
snippet: To achieve a positive return, drugs launched from 2016 to 2020 must generate nearly $12 billion in sales, up from just $1.4 billion for drugs launched in the early 1990s.

title: Seawolf surfaces with $100M, $1.2B Sanofi pact for redosable DNA medicines
